explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 52 named tracks, releases and catalogue references across Resident Advisor's live 2026 review index, Pitchfork's September 8 Memoria review, The Guardian's September 4 current electronic survey, Bandcamp Daily's September 9 survey, and overlooked Jan Jelinek, Computer Soup and Andrew Pekler catalogue criticism; attributed criticism and release metadata only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects, untriggered PARKED revisits, existing utility discoveries and prior unresolved leads without materially new identity evidence were excluded.
Recently decided Andy Stott, Sanskrit, Norberto Lusso, FAUZIA, Container, DJ POPS, FIS, Martyn, Tyler Friedman and Vladislav Delay fields were excluded.

Previously decided Carmen Villain tracks were excluded; only the newly sourced exact track Hey Synapses remains. Earlier RHR and Batu/Donato Dozzy fields were screened but excluded as recently or previously worked.
No Spotify connector, raw audio, audio-feature inference or invented identity was used.
